title: PD_BASELINE_Patient_01
extract_protocol_ch1: PBMC werw extract from blood trough Ficoll Technique

data_processing: The barcoded processing, gene counting were made using the Cell Ranger software v7.0.0 (https://support.10xgenomics.com/single-cell-gene-expression/software/pipelines/latest/what-is-cell-ranger)
